name: gtk6
description: GTK6 — the GTK4 widget/API layer backed by the Qt6 engine. Ships the GTK4 widget layer plus a Qt6-backed GDK display backend, GSK renderer and text bridge; glib/gobject/gio and graphene are vendored under subprojects/.
note: Toolkit package. The Qt6 platform layer (gdk/qt, gsk/qt, qt/) is freestanding C++ built by Makefile; the vendored glib under subprojects/glib is built for the CodeOS target by scripts/build-glib.sh against the CodeOS sysroot (qt6/sysroot).
